review_type: fresh-context independent local style-slice pixel review

scope: Front-office architectural transition, D1 staff door, check-in prop cluster, practical task light, service junction, worker paper/pen/stamp/tray traces. Inherited remainder is ungraded context.

visual_veto.note: Local FAIL is caused by missing polished slice proof of visible localized wear, tactile broad-surface identity and sufficiently bleak localized atmosphere, not a dominant listed veto.

findings.requirement: Front-office architectural transition and negative space
findings.camera_region: SLICE_ENTRY: cream pier/header, black hatch reveal, navy lower wall and quiet wall left of D1; SLICE_DOOR: jamb/lower-wall junction
findings.finding: The hatch and staff door form a legible institutional front. The thick reveal, protective lower zone and quiet wall regions supply believable construction and breathing room. Visual scale is plausible; pixel review does not verify preserved dimensions or route clearance.

findings.requirement: D1 staff door: object-specific angular manufactured construction
findings.camera_region: SLICE_DOOR: door leaf, hinges, handle/lock plate, kick plate and black frame; SLICE_ENTRY: whole silhouette
findings.finding: Pressed-looking clipped-corner panel shapes, hinge hardware, lever escutcheon and separate kick plate give the leaf more construction than a uniform bevelled box. It reads immediately as a usable staff door. The orange coating remains too pristine to demonstrate use.

findings.requirement: Check-in prop cluster and functional hierarchy
findings.camera_region: SLICE_ENTRY: opening and counter; SLICE_MATERIAL: glass/intercom, tray, pen, clipboard, stamp and ink pad
findings.finding: The physical hatch, speaking grille and paperwork surface explain the check-in transaction before reading labels. The front counter is the clear local interaction cluster. A tray, restrained paper stack, fixed pen, form/clipboard, stamp and pad are specific to bureaucratic work. The inherited scanner and rear office objects are context only.

findings.requirement: Practical light, localized falloff, contact and bleak atmosphere
findings.camera_region: SLICE_ENTRY: fixture above hatch, cream header/pier and warm office; SLICE_MATERIAL: counter and rear office wall
findings.finding: The visible practical illuminates its surrounding header and working surface, and the props show local grounding shadows. The ceiling and under-counter areas are dark. However, the cream foreground and rear-office wall receive a broad, comfortable warm exposure; most bleakness comes from navy albedo and the coercive sign. The pool needs more visible falloff and a quieter darker secondary space while retaining door/hatch readability.

findings.camera_region: SLICE_ENTRY: blue box right of door and black conduit to reader; SLICE_DOOR: stepped conduit and clearance reader
findings.finding: A single compact junction and routed conduit explain access service without pipe spaghetti. It has a useful termination and remains subordinate to the door. Close-view fittings and wall contact still require the separate numerical technical review.

findings.requirement: Distinct tactile material families and anti-plastic quality
findings.camera_region: SLICE_DOOR: cream wall, orange leaf, silver hardware and navy panels; SLICE_MATERIAL: counter edge, gray mat, paper, transparent barrier and stamp
findings.finding: Paper is matte and distinct from the transparent barrier; silver hardware has a different highlight from orange paint, and the mat is quieter than the countertop edge. There is no dominant uniform glossy-plastic veto. Yet the broad cream wall, orange paint and gray counter remain smooth and nearly uniform, with less tactile variation than the approved spawn wall/locker references. Rubber versus coated/plastic surfaces is only weakly established, and a fabric response is not evidenced in these frames. This does not prove any such material is absent from the native scene; the slice has not visibly demonstrated the full material gate.

findings.requirement: Localized meaningful wear and maintained deterioration
findings.camera_region: SLICE_DOOR: handle zone, kick plate, panel edges and base; SLICE_MATERIAL: counter working edge, pen zone, tray, stamp/pad and paperwork
findings.finding: No convincing localized wear or repair reads at the supplied framing. The handle zone, kick plate, orange leaf and counter are pristine; props are orderly and fresh. Subtle authored wear may exist in the native asset, but it is not visible evidence. This is the principal missing slice requirement.

findings.requirement: Restrained signage and coercive institutional storytelling
findings.camera_region: SLICE_ENTRY: WE VALUE YOUR TIME / ALL DELAYS ARE YOUR RESPONSIBILITY; SLICE_MATERIAL: STATE YOUR NUMBER and paperwork; SLICE_DOOR: STAFF / 01 and clearance reader
findings.finding: The reassurance with a punitive second line supplies a clear coercive meaning. Labels are few, functional and subordinate to construction. Human work traces are present, but the pristine, evenly aligned cluster communicates a freshly set display more strongly than an institution deteriorating under pressure.

findings.requirement: Spawn colour/craft coherence and angular grounded stylization
findings.camera_region: All three s03 frames, compared with all four spawn-reference frames
findings.finding: Cream, navy, orange, steel and restrained utility accents are coherent with the spawn palette. Door secondary forms and practical objects are grounded rather than toy-like. Spawn-reference plaster variation, locker response and individualized everyday traces show a more tactile finish; s03 does not yet match that craft in its broad surfaces. The concept is directional only and does not authorize changing the inherited layout.

findings.requirement: No generic low-poly, web-demo, sci-fi greeble, excessive labels or photoreal noise
findings.camera_region: All three s03 frames within the front-office slice
findings.finding: No listed dominant visual veto is detected. The focal function is physical and industrial; geometry is angular without an obvious faceted-low-poly read, signage is restrained, and noise is controlled. This absence of a veto does not cure the wear/material/light proof gaps.

prioritized_repair_actions.action: Give the broad front-office surfaces tactile identity and visible local use. Add restrained low-frequency plaster/paint response, handle and kick-plate contact wear, and a short counter/pen working wear zone. Keep most edges clean; do not blanket the slice with grunge or procedural scratches. Make the rubber/plastic/painted-metal distinction readable and demonstrate fabric with one plausible restrained staff-side trace if needed to meet the material gate.

Shape the practical light into a more localized working pool. Preserve clear door and hatch silhouettes, reduce the broadly bright warm secondary office fill, and introduce restrained warm/cool separation and visible falloff. Keep contact shadow and material highlights readable; a navy surface alone should not carry the bleak atmosphere.

Turn the tidy paperwork set into a visibly worked station using two or three deliberate imperfections: one offset/creased form, a used ink surface or stamp contact trace, and one rubbed pen/counter contact. Keep the existing functional cluster and negative space. Avoid adding unrelated props or further warning signs.

baseline_comparison.note: Baseline C03/C01 and s03 use different framing; comparisons are qualitative only. The hatch/intercom, D1 construction, palette and punitive sign are clearer than baseline. The old pale, evenly exposed material response is substantially reduced but pristine broad surfaces remain.

limits: No builder code was read and no native scene or source/model/script was authored by this critic.
No full-room category scores or overall score are awarded. The full-room bar remains strictly above 93 in every category.

This review does not certify layout preservation, geometry/support contact, material-family counts, editable source, dependencies, minimum full review cycles, cold-open/render stability, runtime or engine performance.
The slice manifest records cold_open false and source_saved false; neither is presented as a technical PASS.
